narration.full_text: Namaste students! Welcome to our exciting journey into the world of Arithmetic Progressions. In this chapter, we'll explore fascinating patterns in numbers, learn how to identify them, and master the formulas to solve various problems. Get ready to discover the logic behind sequences and series!
